verses.original: וַיָּ֣שֶׁב אֹתִ֗י דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֤עַר הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ הַֽחִיצ֔וֹן הַפֹּנֶ֖ה קָדִ֑ים וְה֖וּא סָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šeḇ ’ō·ṯî de·reḵ ša·‘ar ham·miq·dāš ha·ḥî·ṣō·wn hap·pō·neh qā·ḏîm wə·hū sā·ḡūr
verses.literal: The man then brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary that faced east but it was shut

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהוָ֗ה הַשַּׁ֣עַר הַזֶּה֩ סָג֨וּר יִהְיֶ֜ה לֹ֣א יִפָּתֵ֗חַ וְאִישׁ֙ לֹא־ יָ֣בֹא ב֔וֹ כִּ֛י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּ֣א ב֑וֹ וְהָיָ֖ה סָגֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay Yah·weh haš·ša·‘ar haz·zeh sā·ḡūr yih·yeh lō yip·pā·ṯê·aḥ wə·’îš lō- yā·ḇō ḇōw kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê- yiś·rā·’êl bā ḇōw wə·hā·yāh sā·ḡūr
verses.literal: And the LORD said to me This gate is to remain shut It shall not be opened and no man shall enter through it because the LORD the God of Israel has entered through it Therefore it will remain shut

verses.original: אֶֽת־ הַנָּשִׂ֗יא נָ֥שִׂיא ה֛וּא יֵֽשֶׁב־ בּ֥וֹ לֶאֱכָול־ לֶ֖חֶם לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה מִדֶּ֨רֶךְ אֻלָ֤ם הַשַּׁ֙עַר֙ יָב֔וֹא וּמִדַּרְכּ֖וֹ יֵצֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- han·nā·śî nā·śî hū yê·šeḇ- bōw le·’ĕ·ḵō·wl- lɛ·ḥɛm lip̄·nê Yah·weh mid·de·reḵ ’u·lām haš·ša·‘ar yā·ḇō·w ū·mid·dar·kōw yê·ṣê
verses.literal: Only the prince . . . himself may sit inside the gateway to eat . . . in the presence of the LORD He must enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way

verses.original: וַיְבִיאֵ֜נִי דֶּֽרֶךְ־ שַׁ֣עַר הַצָּפוֹן֮ אֶל־ פְּנֵ֣י הַבַּיִת֒ וָאֵ֕רֶא וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־ יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ בֵּ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־ פָּנָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḇî·’ê·nî de·reḵ- ša·‘ar haṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ’el- pə·nê hab·ba·yiṯ wā·’ê·re wə·hin·nêh mā·lê ḵə·ḇō·wḏ- Yah·weh ’eṯ- bêṯ Yah·weh wā·’ep·pōl ’el- pā·nāy
verses.literal: Then the man brought me to the front of the temple by way of the north gate I looked and saw the glory of the LORD filling His temple and I fell facedown . . .

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֵלַ֜י יְהֹוָ֗ה בֶּן־ אָדָ֡ם שִׂ֣ים לִבְּךָ֩ וּרְאֵ֨ה בְעֵינֶ֜יךָ וּבְאָזְנֶ֣יךָ שְּׁמָ֗ע אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אֲנִי֙ מְדַבֵּ֣ר אֹתָ֔ךְ לְכָל־ חֻקּ֥וֹת בֵּית־ יְהוָ֖ה וּלְכָל־ תּוֹרֹתוֹ וְשַׂמְתָּ֤ לִבְּךָ֙ לִמְב֣וֹא הַבַּ֔יִת בְּכֹ֖ל מוֹצָאֵ֥י הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay Yah·weh ben- ’ā·ḏām śîm lib·bə·ḵā ū·rə·’êh ḇə·‘ê·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·’ā·zə·ne·ḵā šə·mā‘ ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ’ă·nî mə·ḏab·bêr ’ō·ṯāḵ lə·ḵāl ḥuq·qō·wṯ bêṯ- Yah·weh ū·lə·ḵāl- tō·rō·ṯō wə·śam·tā lib·bə·ḵā lim·ḇō·w hab·ba·yiṯ bə·ḵōl mō·w·ṣā·’ê ham·miq·dāš
verses.literal: The LORD said to me Son of man pay attention . . . look carefully with your eyes and listen closely with your ears to everything I tell you concerning all the statutes and laws of the house of the LORD Take careful note . . . of the entrance to the temple along with all the exits of the sanctuary

verses.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֶל־ מֶ֙רִי֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה רַב־ לָכֶ֛ם מִֽכָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar·tā ’el- me·rî ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh raḇ- lā·ḵem mik·kāl tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Tell . . . the rebellious . . . house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says I have had enough of all your abominations O house of Israel

verses.original: בַּהֲבִיאֲכֶ֣ם בְּנֵֽי־ נֵכָ֗ר עַרְלֵי־ לֵב֙ וְעַרְלֵ֣י בָשָׂ֔ר לִהְי֥וֹת בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לְחַלְּל֣וֹ אֶת־ בֵּיתִ֑י בְּהַקְרִֽיבְכֶ֤ם אֶת־ לַחְמִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם וַיָּפֵ֙רוּ֙ אֶת־ בְּרִיתִ֔י אֶ֖ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ba·hă·ḇî·’ă·ḵem bə·nê- nê·ḵār ‘ar·lê- lêḇ wə·‘ar·lê ḇā·śār lih·yō·wṯ bə·miq·dā·šî lə·ḥal·lə·lōw ’eṯ- bê·ṯî bə·haq·rî·ḇə·ḵem ’eṯ- laḥ·mî ḥê·leḇ wā·ḏām way·yā·p̄ê·rū ’eṯ- bə·rî·ṯî ’el kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: In addition to all your other abominations you brought in foreigners . . . uncircumcised in both heart . . . and flesh to occupy My sanctuary you defiled My temple when you offered My food the fat and the blood you broke My covenant

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א שְׁמַרְתֶּ֖ם מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת קָדָשָׁ֑י וַתְּשִׂימ֗וּן לְשֹׁמְרֵ֧י מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֛י בְּמִקְדָּשִׁ֖י לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō šə·mar·tem miš·me·reṯ qā·ḏā·šāy wat·tə·śî·mūn lə·šō·mə·rê miš·mar·tî bə·miq·dā·šî lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And you have not kept charge of My holy things but have appointed others to keep charge of My sanctuary for you

verses.original: כֹּה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ כָּל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֗ר עֶ֤רֶל לֵב֙ וְעֶ֣רֶל בָּשָׂ֔ר לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֑י לְכָל־ בֶּן־ נֵכָ֔ר אֲשֶׁ֕ר בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh kāl- ben- nê·ḵār ‘e·rel lêḇ wə·‘e·rel bā·śār lō yā·ḇō·w ’el- miq·dā·šî lə·ḵāl ben- nê·ḵār ’ă·šer bə·ṯō·wḵ bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says No foreigner . . . uncircumcised in heart . . . and flesh may enter . . . My sanctuary . . . not even a foreigner . . . who lives among the Israelites . . .

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ הַלְוִיִּ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר רָֽחֲקוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י בִּתְע֤וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּע֣וּ מֵֽעָלַ֔י אַחֲרֵ֖י גִּלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֑ם וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- hal·wî·yim ’ă·šer rā·ḥă·qū mê·‘ā·lay biṯ·‘ō·wṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer tā·‘ū mê·‘ā·lay ’a·ḥă·rê gil·lū·lê·hem wə·nā·śə·’ū ‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: Surely . . . the Levites who wandered away from Me when Israel went astray and who wandered away from Me after their idols will bear the consequences of their iniquity

verses.original: וְהָי֤וּ בְמִקְדָּשִׁי֙ מְשָׁ֣רְתִ֔ים פְּקֻדּוֹת֙ אֶל־ שַׁעֲרֵ֣י הַבַּ֔יִת וּֽמְשָׁרְתִ֖ים אֶת־ הַבָּ֑יִת הֵ֠מָּה יִשְׁחֲט֨וּ אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֤ה וְאֶת־ הַזֶּ֙בַח֙ לָעָ֔ם וְהֵ֛מָּה יַעַמְד֥וּ לִפְנֵיהֶ֖ם לְשָֽׁרְתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū ḇə·miq·dā·šî mə·šā·rə·ṯîm pə·qud·dō·wṯ ’el- ša·‘ă·rê hab·ba·yiṯ ū·mə·šā·rə·ṯîm ’eṯ- hab·bā·yiṯ hêm·māh yiš·ḥă·ṭū ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- haz·ze·ḇaḥ lā·‘ām wə·hêm·māh ya·‘am·ḏū lip̄·nê·hem lə·šā·rə·ṯām
verses.literal: Yet they shall be ministers in My sanctuary having charge of the gates of the temple and ministering there They shall slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people . . . and stand before them to minister to them

verses.original: יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר יְשָׁרְת֤וּ אוֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֔ם וְהָי֥וּ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עָוֺ֑ן עַל־ כֵּן֩ נָשָׂ֨אתִי יָדִ֜י עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ya·‘an ’ă·šer yə·šā·rə·ṯū ’ō·w·ṯām lip̄·nê ḡil·lū·lê·hem wə·hā·yū lə·ḇêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl lə·miḵ·šō·wl ‘ā·wōn ‘al- kên nā·śā·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ă·lê·hem nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh wə·nā·śə·’ū ‘ă·wō·nām
verses.literal: Because they ministered before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel therefore . . . I swore with an uplifted hand concerning them that they would bear the consequences of their iniquity declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ יִגְּשׁ֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לְכַהֵ֣ן לִ֔י וְלָגֶ֙שֶׁת֙ עַל־ כָּל־ קָ֣דָשַׁ֔י אֶל־ קָדְשֵׁ֖י הַקְּדָשִׁ֑ים וְנָֽשְׂאוּ֙ כְּלִמָּתָ֔ם וְתוֹעֲבוֹתָ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשֽׂוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- yig·gə·šū ’ê·lay lə·ḵa·hên lî wə·lā·ḡe·šeṯ ‘al- kāl- qā·ḏā·šay ’el- qā·ḏə·šê haq·qə·ḏā·šîm wə·nā·śə·’ū kə·lim·mā·ṯām wə·ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇō·w·ṯām ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū
verses.literal: They must not approach Me to serve Me as priests or come near . . . any of My holy things . . . or the most holy things . . . They will bear the shame of the abominations they have committed

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֣י אוֹתָ֔ם שֹׁמְרֵ֖י מִשְׁמֶ֣רֶת הַבָּ֑יִת לְכֹל֙ עֲבֹ֣דָת֔וֹ וּלְכֹ֛ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה בּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’ō·w·ṯām šō·mə·rê miš·me·reṯ hab·bā·yiṯ lə·ḵōl ‘ă·ḇō·ḏā·ṯōw ū·lə·ḵōl ’ă·šer yê·‘ā·śeh bōw
verses.literal: Yet I will appoint them to keep charge of all the work for the temple and everything to be done in it

verses.original: וְהַכֹּהֲנִ֨ים הַלְוִיִּ֜ם בְּנֵ֣י צָד֗וֹק אֲשֶׁ֨ר שָׁמְר֜וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֤רֶת מִקְדָּשִׁי֙ בִּתְע֤וֹת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י הֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֵלַ֖י לְשָֽׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְעָמְד֣וּ לְפָנַ֗י לְהַקְרִ֥יב לִי֙ חֵ֣לֶב וָדָ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm hal·wî·yim bə·nê ṣā·ḏō·wq ’ă·šer šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·me·reṯ miq·dā·šî biṯ·‘ō·wṯ bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mê·‘ā·lay hêm·māh yiq·rə·ḇū ’ê·lay lə·šā·rə·ṯê·nî wə·‘ā·mə·ḏū lə·p̄ā·nay lə·haq·rîḇ lî ḥê·leḇ wā·ḏām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: But the Levitical priests who are descended from Zadok and who kept charge of My sanctuary when the Israelites . . . went astray from Me . . . are to approach Me to minister before Me They will stand before Me to offer Me fat and blood declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: הֵ֜מָּה יָבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ מִקְדָּשִׁ֗י וְהֵ֛מָּה יִקְרְב֥וּ אֶל־ שֻׁלְחָנִ֖י לְשָׁרְתֵ֑נִי וְשָׁמְר֖וּ אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- miq·dā·šî wə·hêm·māh yiq·rə·ḇū ’el- šul·ḥā·nî lə·šā·rə·ṯê·nî wə·šā·mə·rū ’eṯ- miš·mar·tî
verses.literal: They alone shall enter . . . My sanctuary . . . and draw near to My table to minister before Me They will keep My charge

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּבוֹאָם֙ אֶֽל־ שַׁעֲרֵי֙ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַפְּנִימִ֔ית בִּגְדֵ֥י פִשְׁתִּ֖ים יִלְבָּ֑שׁוּ וְלֹֽא־ יַעֲלֶ֤ה עֲלֵיהֶם֙ צֶ֔מֶר בְּשָֽׁרְתָ֗ם בְּשַׁעֲרֵ֛י הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִ֖ית וָבָֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·ḇō·w·’ām ’el- ša·‘ă·rê he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ biḡ·ḏê p̄iš·tîm yil·bā·šū wə·lō- ya·‘ă·leh ‘ă·lê·hem ṣe·mer bə·šā·rə·ṯām bə·ša·‘ă·rê he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ wā·ḇā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: When they enter . . . the gates of the inner court they are to wear linen garments they must not wear anything made of wool when they minister at the gates of the inner court or inside the temple

verses.original: פַּאֲרֵ֤י פִשְׁתִּים֙ יִהְי֣וּ עַל־ רֹאשָׁ֔ם וּמִכְנְסֵ֣י פִשְׁתִּ֔ים יִהְי֖וּ עַל־ מָתְנֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א יַחְגְּר֖וּ בַּיָּֽזַע׃
verses.transliteration: pa·’ă·rê p̄iš·tîm yih·yū ‘al- rō·šām ū·miḵ·nə·sê p̄iš·tîm yih·yū ‘al- mā·ṯə·nê·hem lō yaḥ·gə·rū bay·yā·za‘
verses.literal: They are to wear linen . . . turbans on their heads and linen . . . undergarments around their waists They must not wear anything that makes them perspire

verses.original: וּ֠בְצֵאתָם אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֨ר הַחִיצוֹנָ֜ה אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֣ר הַחִיצוֹנָה֮ אֶל־ הָעָם֒ יִפְשְׁט֣וּ אֶת־ בִּגְדֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר־ הֵ֙מָּה֙ מְשָׁרְתִ֣ם בָּ֔ם וְהִנִּ֥יחוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בְּלִֽשְׁכֹ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְלָֽבְשׁוּ֙ בְּגָדִ֣ים אֲחֵרִ֔ים וְלֹֽא־ יְקַדְּשׁ֥וּ אֶת־ הָעָ֖ם בְּבִגְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·ṣê·ṯām ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr ha·ḥî·ṣō·w·nāh ’el- hā·‘ām yip̄·šə·ṭū ’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê·hem ’ă·šer- hêm·māh mə·šā·rə·ṯim bām wə·hin·nî·ḥū ’ō·w·ṯām bə·liš·ḵōṯ haq·qō·ḏeš wə·lā·ḇə·šū bə·ḡā·ḏîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm wə·lō- yə·qad·də·šū ’eṯ- hā·‘ām bə·ḇiḡ·ḏê·hem
verses.literal: When they go out to the outer court to . . . . . . . . . the people they are to take off the garments in which they have ministered leave them in the holy chambers and dress in other clothes so that they do not transmit holiness to the people with their garments

verses.original: וְרֹאשָׁם֙ לֹ֣א יְגַלֵּ֔חוּ וּפֶ֖רַע לֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑חוּ כָּס֥וֹם יִכְסְמ֖וּ אֶת־ רָאשֵׁיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rō·šām lō yə·ḡal·lê·ḥū ū·p̄e·ra‘ lō yə·šal·lê·ḥū kā·sō·wm yiḵ·sə·mū ’eṯ- rā·šê·hem
verses.literal: They must not shave their heads or let their hair . . . grow long but must carefully trim . . . their hair

verses.original: וְיַ֥יִן לֹֽא־ יִשְׁתּ֖וּ כָּל־ כֹּהֵ֑ן בְּבוֹאָ֖ם אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ya·yin lō- yiš·tū kāl- kō·hên bə·ḇō·w·’ām ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ
verses.literal: No priest may drink . . . wine before he enters . . . the inner court

verses.original: וְאַלְמָנָה֙ וּגְרוּשָׁ֔ה לֹֽא־ יִקְח֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם לְנָשִׁ֑ים כִּ֣י אִם־ בְּתוּלֹ֗ת מִזֶּ֙רַע֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְהָֽאַלְמָנָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּֽהְיֶ֣ה אַלְמָנָ֔ה מִכֹּהֵ֖ן יִקָּֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’al·mā·nāh ū·ḡə·rū·šāh lō- yiq·ḥū lā·hem lə·nā·šîm kî ’im- bə·ṯū·lōṯ miz·ze·ra‘ bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·hā·’al·mā·nāh ’ă·šer tih·yeh ’al·mā·nāh mik·kō·hên yiq·qā·ḥū
verses.literal: And they shall not marry . . . a widow or a divorced woman but must marry a virgin of the descendants of the house of Israel . . . or a widow - of a priest

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַמִּ֣י יוֹר֔וּ בֵּ֥ין קֹ֖דֶשׁ לְחֹ֑ל וּבֵין־ טָמֵ֥א לְטָה֖וֹר יוֹדִעֻֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘am·mî yō·w·rū bên qō·ḏeš lə·ḥōl ū·ḇên- ṭā·mê lə·ṭā·hō·wr yō·w·ḏi·‘um
verses.literal: They are to teach My people the difference between the holy and the common and show them how to discern between the clean and the unclean

verses.original: וְעַל־ רִ֗יב הֵ֚מָּה יַעַמְד֣וּ לִשְׁפֹּט בְּמִשְׁפָּטַ֖י וְשָׁפְטֻהוּ וְאֶת־ תּוֹרֹתַ֤י וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ בְּכָל־ מוֹעֲדַ֣י יִשְׁמֹ֔רוּ וְאֶת־ שַׁבְּתוֹתַ֖י יְקַדֵּֽשׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- rîḇ hêm·māh ya·‘am·ḏū liš·pōṭ bə·miš·pā·ṭay wə·šå̄·p̄ə·ṭu·hū wə·’eṯ- tō·w·rō·ṯay wə·’eṯ- ḥuq·qō·ṯay bə·ḵāl mō·w·‘ă·ḏay yiš·mō·rū wə·’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·w·ṯay yə·qad·dê·šū
verses.literal: In any dispute they shall officiate as judges and judge according to My ordinances They must keep My laws and statutes regarding all My appointed feasts and they must keep My Sabbaths holy

verses.original: וְאֶל־ מֵ֣ת אָדָ֔ם לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא לְטָמְאָ֑ה כִּ֣י אִם־ לְאָ֡ב וּ֠לְאֵם וּלְבֵ֨ן וּלְבַ֜ת לְאָ֗ח וּלְאָח֛וֹת אֲשֶֽׁר־ לֹא־ הָיְתָ֥ה לְאִ֖ישׁ יִטַּמָּֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el- mêṯ ’ā·ḏām lō yā·ḇō·w lə·ṭā·mə·’āh kî ’im- lə·’āḇ ū·lə·’êm ū·lə·ḇên ū·lə·ḇaṯ lə·’āḥ ū·lə·’ā·ḥō·wṯ ’ă·šer- lō- hā·yə·ṯāh lə·’îš yiṭ·ṭam·mā·’ū
verses.literal: A priest must not defile himself by going near a dead person However . . . for a father a mother a son a daughter a brother or an unmarried . . . . . . sister he may do so

verses.original: וְאַחֲרֵ֖י טָֽהֳרָת֑וֹ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִ֖ים יִסְפְּרוּ־ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’a·ḥă·rê ṭā·ho·rā·ṯōw šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm yis·pə·rū- lōw
verses.literal: and after he is cleansed he must count off seven days for himself

verses.original: וּבְיוֹם֩ בֹּא֨וֹ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ אֶל־ הֶחָצֵ֤ר הַפְּנִימִית֙ לְשָׁרֵ֣ת בַּקֹּ֔דֶשׁ יַקְרִ֖יב חַטָּאת֑וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇə·yō·wm bō·’ōw ’el- haq·qō·ḏeš ’el- he·ḥā·ṣêr hap·pə·nî·mîṯ lə·šā·rêṯ baq·qō·ḏeš yaq·rîḇ ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: And on the day he goes into the sanctuary into the inner court to minister in the sanctuary he must present his sin offering declares the Lord GOD

verses.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לְֽנַחֲלָ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נַֽחֲלָתָ֑ם וַאֲחֻזָּ֗ה לֹֽא־ תִתְּנ֤וּ לָהֶם֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֲנִ֖י אֲחֻזָּתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lā·hem lə·na·ḥă·lāh ’ă·nî na·ḥă·lā·ṯām wa·’ă·ḥuz·zāh lō- ṯit·tə·nū lā·hem bə·yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·nî ’ă·ḥuz·zā·ṯām
verses.literal: In regard to their inheritance I am their inheritance You are to give them no possession in Israel for I am their possession

verses.original: הַמִּנְחָה֙ וְהַחַטָּ֣את וְהָאָשָׁ֔ם הֵ֖מָּה יֹֽאכְל֑וּם וְכָל־ חֵ֥רֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לָהֶ֥ם יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·min·ḥāh wə·ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hā·’ā·šām hêm·māh yō·ḵə·lūm wə·ḵāl ḥê·rem bə·yiś·rā·’êl lā·hem yih·yeh
verses.literal: They shall eat the grain offerings the sin offerings and the guilt offerings Everything in Israel devoted to the LORD will belong to them

verses.original: וְרֵאשִׁית֩ כָּל־ בִּכּ֨וּרֵי כֹ֜ל וְכָל־ תְּר֣וּמַת כֹּ֗ל מִכֹּל֙ תְּרוּמ֣וֹתֵיכֶ֔ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים יִֽהְיֶ֑ה וְרֵאשִׁ֤ית עֲרִסֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ תִּתְּנ֣וּ לַכֹּהֵ֔ן לְהָנִ֥יחַ בְּרָכָ֖ה אֶל־ בֵּיתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rê·šîṯ kāl- bik·kū·rê ḵōl wə·ḵāl tə·rū·maṯ kōl mik·kōl tə·rū·mō·w·ṯê·ḵem lak·kō·hă·nîm yih·yeh wə·rê·šîṯ ‘ă·ri·sō·w·ṯê·ḵem tit·tə·nū lak·kō·hên lə·hā·nî·aḥ bə·rā·ḵāh ’el- bê·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: The best of all the firstfruits and of every contribution from all your offerings will belong to the priests You are to give your first batch of dough to the priest so that a blessing may rest upon your homes

verses.original: כָּל־ נְבֵלָה֙ וּטְרֵפָ֔ה מִן־ הָע֖וֹף וּמִן־ הַבְּהֵמָ֑ה לֹ֥א יֹאכְל֖וּ הַכֹּהֲנִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- nə·ḇê·lāh ū·ṭə·rê·p̄āh min- hā·‘ō·wp̄ ū·min- hab·bə·hê·māh lō yō·ḵə·lū hak·kō·hă·nîm
verses.literal: The priests may not eat any bird . . . or animal found dead or torn by wild beasts . . .
